item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. Your day is full, and that's exactly when water slips to the bottom of the list. Dehydration quietly drags down focus, mood, and energy, and it makes patience harder to find. You don't need a perfect system. Tie water to things you already do: one glass with your morning routine, one with your midday meal, one before you wind down. Action: pour a full glass of water right now and finish it.
